Great, thanks Claire — and hi Rajiv. Quick answers to your questions, and a small technical note so your infra folks can prep: 

1) Tool-calling pattern: We recommend the webhook approach for this trial (Redwood calls your product-metadata endpoint). Pros: minimal push work from Orbital, lower storage surface on your side. Cons: adds an external dependency for latency-sensitive calls. If you prefer pushing an index, we support that too via our bulk upload API.

2) Streaming payload limit: Aim for <= 8KB per event (we’ll batch multiple events on our side into micro-batches when possible). If you have larger messages, please flag them and we’ll handle as attachments or separate fetches.

Technical prep items I’m asking Ben/Marissa/Dev to deliver by tomorrow:
- SDK route examples for streaming ingest + sample cURL for REST backfill (sdk_route_snippets.txt) — Ben.
- Dev token and ci-friendly test harness instructions — Marissa.
- Recommended KV cache config and batch tuning doc — Dev.

Rajiv — can you confirm whether you can expose a short-term webhook for metadata? If not, we’ll switch to index push.

Rishi
